box; orange dashed = the pin-clipped centre box (A131). ring = contact at gap < 1e-6; these are the names the PI labels from. | PANEL 3 = the hypothesis alone: the three cores captioned, the clip per tilt sub-bin, the lane <= 1 corner cells and the measured pockets.
